identification: Floor-standing black timber bank of 21 locking post office boxes with cast bronze C of A doors, keys in many, heavy verdigris.

entries.note: Single vintage COA Commonwealth of Australia private box door, 1970s PMG. Best offer accepted, actual price below the shown A$9.99. One loose door only, no cabinet.

viewing_check: Check every door opens and locks, number of keys present, whether the C of A castings are on all doors, rot or borer in the timber carcass, and the overall weight and size for removal. Photograph the back and the base.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: post office boxes brass doors (all US doors, not comparable); australia post office boxes bank vintage timber brass doors keys (one COA door). No Australian bank-of-boxes sale found. Invaluable/LiveAuctioneers not tried.

identification: Red pressed-steel Cyclops pedal car, ute/tray-back style, white disc wheels with chrome hubcaps, timber rear step, later stickers.

entries.note: Vintage 'Cyclops Team' metal pedal car, best offer accepted, actual price below the shown A$95 (A$76 also shown). Model and condition not checked on the listing page, so only a loose guide.
Parts only: set of 3 original Cyclops pedal car hubcaps, best offer accepted so price at or below A$149.95. Shows the hubcaps alone carry value.

viewing_check: Check the Cyclops script hubcaps are all present and original, steering wheel, pedals and chain, rust-through on the body, and whether the timber step is original. Photograph underside and any maker marks.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: cyclops pedal car; cyclops pedal car truck ute vintage. Only complete-car sold result seen was the Cyclops Team one above; the rest were parts. Gowans comps in the brief were not re-checked.

identification: Blue and white vitreous enamel sign 'LEADING NEWSPAPER. THE DAILY TELEGRAPH. TASMANIA.', small 'Made in England' mark lower right, landscape about 3.5:1, rust loss and jagged break at top right corner, otherwise bright face

entries.note: 1950s UK Daily Telegraph stockists enamel sign, 20 x 4.5 in, similar size and format but UK paper, not Tasmanian and later date. Price excludes about A$192 postage estimate.
Same type of 1950s UK Daily Telegraph stockists enamel sign, 20 x 4.5 in. Not Tasmanian. Excludes about A$193 postage estimate.

viewing_check: Check the size of the break top right and how much face enamel is lost, edge chips and fixing holes, and the rust on the back. Look for any Tasmania-specific maker mark. Photograph the 'Made in England' mark and the reverse. Possible Tasmanian collector premium over UK signs, but the Gowans results (A$40 to A$130 recent, A$2,860 in 2024) are very mixed, so check what that A$2,860 piece was.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: enamel sign Tasmania newspaper (UK newspaper signs A$23 to A$556, mostly different papers); Daily Telegraph enamel sign Launceston OR Tasmania (UK Daily Telegraph signs above). No Tasmanian Daily Telegraph sign found sold. Invaluable and LiveAuctioneers not tried for this lot.

identification: Zenit Photosniper FS-12 kit in a black hard case: Zenit body, Tair-3S 300mm f/4.5 lens, gunstock, accessories and manual; shutter jammed per catalogue.

entries.note: FS-12 Photosniper with Tair-3S 300mm and Helios 44M-7, 'full outfit', working status not stated. Best Offer listing, actual price may be lower. Postage about A$199.
FS 12 photo gun with Tair 4.5/300 lens. Best offer accepted, actual price below the shown A$293.61.
Photosniper FS-12 kit, Tair 300mm f/4.5 plus Zenit 12S, pre-owned. Best Offer listing, so actual price may be lower.
FS-12S kit, Tair 300mm plus Zenit 12S, 2 bids. Postage A$21.52.
FS-12 Zenit-ES with Tair-3S 300mm, 1 bid. Postage A$56.65.
FS-12 Zenit-ES set with Tair-3S, boxed, likely in better condition. Best offer accepted, actual price below the shown A$571.35.

viewing_check: Check the body number and that the body is a Zenit 12S or ES, the Tair-3S lens glass for fungus, haze and scratches, whether the focus and aperture rings move, the gunstock and rubber eyecup, and what else is in the case. Try the shutter by hand. Photograph the lens serial.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: zenit photosniper FS-12 (many results, Aug to Nov 2026, working status mostly not stated). Lens is the main value, so a jammed body should matter less.

identification: Bushells BLUE LABEL 'The Tea of Flavor' vitreous enamel advertising sign, blue ground with white and orange lettering, landscape, edge chips and a large chip on the B.

entries.note: Malcolm Moore Engineering Melbourne enamel sign 61x32.5cm, different advertiser, best offer accepted, actual price below the shown A$250. Shows general level for original Australian enamel signs.
Commonwealth Savings Bank double-sided enamel sign, best offer accepted, actual price below the shown A$400. Different brand and double sided, so a higher-demand type.

viewing_check: Check how much enamel is missing (the large chip on the B and edge chips), rust through, bends, whether it is original vitreous enamel (glassy, thick edge) or a reproduction, the four fixing holes, and the back. Photograph the back and the edges. Measure it against 45.5 x 30.5cm.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: bushells blue label enamel sign (only tins, sieves, strainers, no signs); eBay AU sold: bushells enamel sign (only other brands' enamel signs). No Bushells enamel sign sold on eBay in the period. Carters not opened. Cloud comps ($200 Lawsons 2024, $45 Gowans 2025) remain the best guide.

ICOM Navicom IC-A22, works plugged in (battery likely poor), US seller, listed Buy It Now or best offer, so price at or below A$108.05.

viewing_check: Check which model it is on the rear label (IC-A22 vs A22E), whether it powers on and holds a charge on the supplied charger, battery pack condition, antenna, belt clip and cracks. Photograph the label, display and the charger label.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: icom ic-a22 (blank, page did not load); eBay AU sold: icom a22 airband (2 IC-A22 comps above, plus IC-A25N at A$595 to A$633 and IC-A24 for parts A$127, not recorded); eBay US sold skipped, it asks for sign-in.

identification: Green vitreous enamel company name sign 'BP AUSTRALIA LTD.' in yellow serif capitals, portrait format, two fixing holes at top, faint extra line at bottom (Incorporated in Victoria), looks clean on the face with slight edge wear

entries.note: Malcolm Moore Engineering Melbourne enamel sign 61 x 32.5 cm, Australian company name sign. Best offer accepted, actual price below the shown A$250. Different company and format, only shows the market for Australian company name signs.
UK 'The Winner BP' enamel advertising sign, a different BP sign, plus about A$55 postage. Weak comp, shows UK BP enamel at roughly A$110 to A$126.

viewing_check: Measure it (catalogue 54 x 39 cm), check the enamel for chips around the holes, rust on the edges and back, scratches, and read the faint bottom line. Photograph the maker's mark if any. Check it is real vitreous enamel (glassy, chips show iron) and not a modern reproduction. Note that it is a plain company name sign, not a Motor Spirit pump or forecourt sign, so it is worth less than the sought-after BP advertising signs.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: BP Australia Ltd enamel sign (error page twice); BP enamel sign green (UK BP signs A$45 to A$310); BP Australia enamel sign (no BP Australia Ltd sign found). No same-item comps. Gowans comps already found not re-recorded.

Lucas King of the Road F146 brass car lamp, Buy It Now. Brass, different model.

identification: Keen's Genuine Tasmanian Curry Powder tin (Keen's Curry Powder Co, Browns River, Kingston), dark blue and gold lithographed label, small cylindrical canister about 8cm.
viewing_check: Photograph all sides, the lid and base. Check the label for tears and loss, rust at rims, dents, and whether the lid fits. Original contents or any paper label inside add interest. Tasmanian collectors are the likely buyers.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: keen's tasmanian curry (only current Keen's retail curry powder and Keen shoes); antique curry powder tin tasmania kingston (only US curry tins at about A$22, not comparable). Other eBay searches errored. Trade Me and Invaluable not tried. No same-item evidence.

searches_tried: eBay AU sold: atlas copco chipping hammer (one same-type comp, the rest unrelated toys or other brands); atlas copco air hammer chisel (eBay error page). Gumtree not tried. Earlier Gowans comps not re-opened.

identification: Five Trax 1:43 Australian club/member models in perspex display cases: panel vans (green, white, blue), a cream wagon and a pale blue ute with parcels; no boxes shown.

Trax TR53 1962 Holden EJ panel van RACV, pre-owned, or best offer so price paid may be lower. Standard range, not a club model.

viewing_check: Check each model against the case (name on the base or underside, club year), that each is complete (mirrors, wipers, load on the ute), paint chips, and whether any has a box or certificate. Ferris portable 1953-era mains/valve radio, restored and working. Not a car unit; restored condition is better than this lot.

viewing_check: Check for the maker plate and model number on both units, missing knobs, dial glass, cracks in cabinet, rust, and whether the radiogram has its turntable/record arm and power lead. Photograph the plates and back panels. Treat as untested.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: ferris car radiogram (error page); ferris radiogram (no relevant results); ferris vintage car radio valve (two Ferris radio comps above; no sale of a Ferris car radiogram or Stereophonic Master Unit found).

identification: Four red Meccano Hornby O gauge clockwork boxes: two boxed curved rails, one boxed straight rails, and one boxed No.1 level crossing (green crossing with yellow road), all in old red boxes
viewing_check: Open each box: count rails per box, check for rust, bent sleepers and missing pieces, and check the level crossing is complete (gates and base) and the paint is intact. Boxed Hornby O gauge accessories only sell for modest money, so condition and completeness matter most. Photograph the box ends for the item numbers.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: hornby o gauge (worked, but only locos, carriages and keys came up, A$20 to A$107, none of them track or crossings); several track or crossing queries returned an eBay error page repeatedly (looks like throttling), ebay.com worldwide showed a sign-in wall so skipped. No same-item comps found.

entries.note: Duravit 070350 Vero wall-mount sink, new, much smaller (about 50 x 25 cm) and a different model. Best offer accepted, actual price below the shown A$253.86. Postage A$306.

searches_tried: eBay AU sold: duravit vero washbasin 600 (no same-model sale); duravit 0453600000 (eBay error page). Heavy item with high postage, so local pick-up value is the relevant comp, which the Gowans sales already cover.

identification: Finished OO gauge scenic model railway layout on one large baseboard (about 8x4 ft), double oval with station, sidings, card-kit town and backscene; no locos or rolling stock seen.
viewing_check: Measure the baseboard and check how it comes apart for transport. Test whether the track is live and the wiring/controller present, and look for track damage, warped board and fragile buildings. Photograph the underside and any included locos or stock (none seen).
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: oo gauge model railway layout baseboard (errored); oo gauge layout (only parts, track packs and scenery kits, A$5-405; no complete scenic layout sold). No same-item comps; complete layouts mostly sell locally and heavily discounted because of size.

identification: Pair of black cloth SAAS reclining sports bucket seats with embroidered SAAS headrest logos, look clean and near new, no rails or sliders visible.

entries.note: SAAS Kombat Black Dual Recline X2 pair, brand NEW from a dealer. Model may differ from the Armitage seats and these are new, not used. Gives the new-price ceiling.

viewing_check: Read the model name on the label or tag, check for sliders or mounting brackets (without them they need rails fitted), the recline levers on both sides, tears, stains, and whether tags or packaging are still on. Photograph the label.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold 'saas bucket seats pair' (one new SAAS pair sold; others other brands); 'saas dual recline seats used' hit an eBay error page. No used SAAS sold price seen.

identification: Dexter carbon steel meat cleaver with wooden handle (pitted and rusty) together with a stainless steel chain mesh butcher's apron with straps.

entries.note: Vintage Dexter 5387 7in butcher cleaver, carbon steel, wood handle, marked, Buy It Now, US seller, postage A$38.65 extra. Cleaver only, and likely in better condition than the lot.
Vintage Dexter Chinese chef cleaver 7in, high carbon steel, wood handle, Buy It Now, US seller, postage A$59.39 extra. Cleaver only.

viewing_check: Check the cleaver blade for the Dexter or Dexter-Russell stamp, depth of pitting and rust, cracks, and whether the handle is tight. For the apron, check whether the mesh is intact (no broken or missing rings), the rings are stainless, the straps and clips are sound, and the size. Photograph the maker tag on the apron if any.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: dexter cleaver (cleavers A$14-$151, the cheapest ones are poor condition or mixed lots). eBay AU sold: chain mail butcher apron, butcher chainmail apron stainless (eBay error page both times, no apron comps). Apron value not established. Cloud Gowans comps ($35-$115) remain the best guide.

searches_tried: eBay AU sold: michelin man cardboard standup display (error page); michelin man standup (only metal signs and small items); michelin man corflute (error page). No corflute or cardboard stand-up sale found.

identification: Large framed display: red Stratocaster-style electric guitar (Squier type) with faint signatures on the scratchplate, a U2 Joshua Tree LP and sleeve, a band photo and two plaques on blue mount in a silver frame
viewing_check: Photograph the scratchplate signatures close up in good light and compare with known U2 autographs (Bono, Edge, Adam Clayton, Larry Mullen Jr). Photograph the Helping Hand Group COA (no. 16575) and plaques in full. Check headstock logo for Squier vs Fender, whether the guitar is actually fixed in the frame, glass condition and the frame size (91 x 111 cm). Signatures look faint, so check for fading.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: u2 signed guitar, u2 signed guitar framed, u2 autographed guitar (all returned an eBay error page, apparently throttled, so no results); ebay.com worldwide showed a sign-in wall, skipped. No new evidence; earlier Gowans A$260 and RR Auction 2013 comps not re-recorded.
